What is implemented

Independent JavaScript using recovered drag scaling, gravity-before-movement integration, immediate launch displacement, endpoint and midpoint collision sampling, the basic 30-frame firing cooldown, and base-arrow damage variation against recovered troop health/resistance. Fixed-step simulation is tested across seven rendering rates.

What is still different

  • Full terrain, unit AI, animation, damage reactions and campaign are not implemented
  • Target placement, rectangular hitboxes and artwork are new diagnostic fixtures
  • Input is sampled at 33Hz; circular button edges and live Flash comparison remain unverified
  • Damage uses a reproducible test seed, not the original Flash random generator
